items.text: Make mise the primary package manager for runtimes, language-level global packages, and Homebrew-managed formulae.
Use mise tool backends for CLIs that need version switching.
Use mise's built-in Homebrew bootstrap manager for packages that still need Homebrew formula artifacts.
Keep the existing Homebrew cask flow; don't move casks to mise.
Default Node, Python, and Ruby packages are currently managed outside mise-config.toml.
The mise config file is mise-config.toml.
Homebrew currently owns a broader package set and bootstraps Ansible before mise is installed.
Move default package behavior (Node/Python/Ruby global packages) into mise TOML config.
Mise deprecates default Python package files: warnings in 2026.11.0, removal in 2027.11.0.
Configured tool versions should be explicit, with less overlap in tool ownership.
Mise 2026.7.5 already exposes the `mise bootstrap packages` command.
The mise `brew:` manager installs formulae into the canonical prefix without needing Homebrew installed.
Mise `brew-cask:` has narrower platform and lifecycle coverage.
Mise orchestrates the remaining Homebrew artifacts, replacing the separate Ansible Homebrew modules and Brewfile flows.
Bootstrap should be consolidated under mise.
